meta.provenance_note: Read directly from the PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-19 — extraction is clean (this book is in English). Same treatment as iqra_curriculum_g1_english_sem1.json: unit titles, page numbers, vocabulary, grammar phrases, and listening skill descriptors taken from the book's own two-page 'Scope and sequence' table (pp. 4-5); the Speaking/Reading/Writing/Project/Viewing columns on page 5 were not used. Each numbered unit is split into two lessons — Vocabulary & Grammar, and Listening & Speaking. Unlike g1EnglishSem1.json's Welcome unit, this Grade's Welcome unit DOES carry a full Grammar and Listening entry in the table, so it uses the same two-lesson shape as every numbered unit.
known_gaps: This is real content (vocabulary lists, grammar phrases, listening skill descriptors), not title-only — but it is unit-level, not lesson-level: each unit's actual internal lesson count and exact per-page lesson titles were not verified page by page.

Following the established English-subject precedent, `main_idea_ar` and `objectives` hold literal English text (this book's own language), not Arabic; `title_ar` carries a plain Arabic gloss of the English title for search/display.

Phonics letter/word-family lists printed inside the table's Vocabulary column are excluded from `vocabulary` — they are letter-sound drill items, not thematic vocabulary, and this schema has no separate field for them.

Unit 1's 'Unit objectives' table cell did not extract (the table jumps directly from the page number to the Vocabulary column for this one row only, unlike every other unit) — `general_idea_ar` is left empty for u1 rather than invented; every other unit's objectives cell extracted cleanly.
